scope: The neoclassical exterior of La Plata Museum during the 1912 Holland expedition, with its six-column entrance, raised rotunda, curved gallery wings and original courtyard configuration.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The museum gives its 135 by 70 metre envelope, two hemicycles, original courts, 1920s library date, upper floor at 3 metres, granite steps and six Corinthian columns.
The University architectural history distinguishes the executed plans from the 1885 proposal and records the original gallery and rotunda arrangement.
The museum documents Holland’s 1912 visit, which dates the appearance represented by the plate.
